summary: Full backend + frontend testing for GateFlow MVP. Backend: 20/20 pytest cases pass (auth for 3 roles, role protection, full delivery lifecycle expected→arrived→picked_up, wrong-OTP rejection, walk-in, capacity full 409, admin stats/capacity update, notifications). Frontend: end-to-end flow via Playwright covering learner demo login → register expected → WhatsApp drawer, guard login → mark arrived (delivery room) → verify pickup dialog with wrong OTP → walk-in dialog, admin login → all 4 KPIs → capacity update persisted (set 45, reload placeholder=45, restored to 40) → deliveries table. All data-testids present and functional. Test deliveries created during testing were cleaned up and capacity restored to 40.

design_issues.screen: Multiple dialogs (arrive-dialog, pickup-dialog, walkin-dialog, whatsapp drawer)
issues: Radix a11y warning: DialogContent missing DialogTitle / aria-describedby in some dialogs (walkin/pickup/whatsapp drawer). Non-blocking but flagged by Radix in the console.

action_items: (Nit) Add DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden wrapped) + DialogDescription to all Dialog components to silence Radix a11y warnings and improve screen-reader accessibility.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:139 next_free_slot uses O(n) scan for each arrive/walkin – fine at capacity ≤500 but noted.
server.py:196 GET /api/deliveries returns up to 1000 docs unpaginated; add pagination before scale.
AdminDashboard.jsx polls every 10s and re-renders full recharts trees; consider useMemo/memoization for large delivery tables.
Frontend: apiError toast handles server 400/403/409 uniformly; good.
seed_data_creation: None persistent – test deliveries were created and then picked-up/deleted; capacity restored to 40; DB back to seeded state (10 historical picked_up + a handful created during the run all now picked_up).

context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py at /app/backend/tests covers all endpoints and can be reused as regression. Frontend Playwright script embedded in iteration; storage radios are visually-hidden inside labels, click the label element via selector 'label:has([data-testid="storage-room-option"])'. Pytest uses xdist -n 2 --dist loadscope, so TestDeliveryFlow class-scoped state (created_ids/otp) works because same-class tests share a worker.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects found. All acceptance criteria in the review request met.
